SELECT t.type, t.create_time AS createTime, t.data::text AS data FROM ( -- 事件创建（仅查询一次，使用索引idx_event_timeline） SELECT 'event_created' AS type, e.create_time, json_build_object( 'eventCode', e.event_code, 'eventName', COALESCE(e.event_name, e.event_code), 'eventLevel', e.event_level, 'status', e.status )::text AS data FROM emergency_event e WHERE e.id = #{eventId} AND e.deleted = FALSE
UNION ALL
-- 事件状态变更历史 SELECT 'event_status_change' AS type, h.operate_time AS create_time, json_build_object( 'fromStatus', h.from_status, 'toStatus', h.to_status, 'reason', h.reason, 'operatorName', h.operator_name )::text AS data FROM emergency_event_status_history h WHERE h.emergency_event_id = #{eventId}
UNION ALL
-- 任务历史记录（支持预警阶段和响应阶段） -- 预警阶段：responseId为null时，查询response_id为null的任务历史 -- 响应阶段：responseId不为null时，查询该响应的任务历史（包含预警阶段任务，如果它们后来被关联到响应） SELECT CONCAT('task_', h2.type) AS type, h2.create_time, json_build_object( 'taskId', h2.task_id, 'taskName', COALESCE(task.title, task.task_code), 'taskStatus', task.status, 'fromStatus', h2.from_status, 'toStatus', h2.to_status, 'comment', h2.reason, 'attachments', NULL, 'timelyReport', NULL, 'reason', h2.reason, 'stage', task.stage )::text AS data FROM emergency_task_history h2 LEFT JOIN emergency_task task ON task.id = h2.task_id AND task.deleted = FALSE WHERE task.event_id = #{eventId}
-- 预警阶段：只查response_id为null的任务历史 AND h2.response_id IS NULL
-- 响应阶段：查该响应的任务历史，同时包含预警阶段任务（response_id为null） AND (h2.response_id = #{responseId} OR h2.response_id IS NULL)
UNION ALL
-- 任务记录（使用索引idx_task_timeline优化） SELECT CONCAT('task_', t.status) AS type, t.create_time, json_build_object( 'taskId', t.id, 'taskName', COALESCE(t.title, t.task_code), 'taskStatus', t.status, 'stage', t.stage )::text AS data FROM emergency_task t WHERE t.event_id = #{eventId} AND t.deleted = FALSE
UNION ALL
-- 资源调度（使用索引idx_dispatch_timeline优化） SELECT 'resource_dispatch' AS type, d.create_time, json_build_object( 'dispatchId', d.id, 'dispatchNo', d.dispatch_no, 'resourceId', d.resource_id, 'resourceName', r.name, 'dispatchStatus', d.status, 'stage', d.stage )::text AS data FROM resource_dispatch d LEFT JOIN resource_pool r ON r.id = d.resource_id WHERE d.event_id = #{eventId} AND d.deleted = FALSE
UNION ALL
-- 内部上报（使用索引idx_report_internal_timeline优化） SELECT 'event_report_internal' AS type, r.report_time AS create_time, json_build_object( 'content', r.content, 'attachments', r.attachments, 'reporterName', r.reporter_name )::text AS data FROM emergency_event_report_internal r WHERE r.emergency_event_id = #{eventId} AND r.deleted = FALSE
UNION ALL
-- 外部上报（使用索引idx_report_external_timeline优化） SELECT 'event_report_external' AS type, r.report_time AS create_time, json_build_object( 'content', r.description_part1, 'reportOrgName', r.report_org_name, 'reporterName', r.reporter_name, 'reporterContact', r.reporter_phone, 'attachments', r.attachments, 'auditStatus', r.audit_status )::text AS data FROM emergency_event_report_external r WHERE r.emergency_event_id = #{eventId} AND r.deleted = FALSE
UNION ALL
-- 评估记录（使用索引idx_assess_timeline优化） SELECT 'event_assess' AS type, a.assess_time AS create_time, json_build_object( 'originalLevel', a.original_level, 'newLevel', a.new_level, 'reason', a.reason, 'meetingRecord', a.meeting_record )::text AS data FROM emergency_event_assess a WHERE a.emergency_event_id = #{eventId} AND a.deleted = FALSE
UNION ALL
-- 处置记录（使用索引idx_handling_timeline优化） SELECT 'event_handling' AS type, h.handling_time AS create_time, json_build_object( 'handlingId', h.id, 'handlerName', h.handler_name, 'measures', h.measures, 'results', h.results )::text AS data FROM emergency_event_handling h WHERE h.emergency_event_id = #{eventId} AND h.deleted = FALSE ) t ORDER BY t.create_time
ASC
DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM ( -- 事件创建（仅1条） SELECT 1 AS cnt FROM emergency_event WHERE id = #{eventId} AND deleted = FALSE UNION ALL -- 事件状态变更（从状态历史表） SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM emergency_event_status_history WHERE emergency_event_id = #{eventId} UNION ALL -- 任务记录 SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM emergency_task WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND deleted = FALSE UNION ALL -- 任务历史记录（支持预警阶段和响应阶段） SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM emergency_task_history h2 LEFT JOIN emergency_task task ON task.id = h2.task_id AND task.deleted = FALSE WHERE task.event_id = #{eventId}
-- 预警阶段：只查response_id为null的任务历史 AND h2.response_id IS NULL
-- 响应阶段：查该响应的任务历史，同时包含预警阶段任务（response_id为null） AND (h2.response_id = #{responseId} OR h2.response_id IS NULL)
UNION ALL -- 资源调度 SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM resource_dispatch WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND deleted = FALSE UNION ALL -- 内部上报 SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM emergency_event_report_internal WHERE emergency_event_id = #{eventId} AND deleted = FALSE UNION ALL -- 外部上报 SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM emergency_event_report_external WHERE emergency_event_id = #{eventId} AND deleted = FALSE UNION ALL -- 评估记录 SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM emergency_event_assess WHERE emergency_event_id = #{eventId} AND deleted = FALSE UNION ALL -- 处置记录 SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM emergency_event_handling WHERE emergency_event_id = #{eventId} AND deleted = FALSE ) x
